# Engineering Notebook Templates {.unnumbered #sec-appendix-notebook-templates}

This appendix provides clean, standardized templates for the core engineering schemas and contracts that compose the **Physical AI engineering notebook**. Every chapter in the curriculum defines or freezes one of these schemas.

## Loop Charter (@sec-boundary)

```yaml
loop_charter:
  version: "1.0"
  system_name: "Physical Agent Handling Station"
  physical_boundary:
    operating_space: "Tabletop 50cm x 50cm workspace"
    actuation_degrees_of_freedom: 2
    maximum_kinetic_energy_joules: 1.2
  learned_components:
    - name: "VisionAffordanceEncoder"
      role: "Propose 3D grasp coordinates"
      privilege_level: "UNTRUSTED_PROPOSAL"
  authority_boundary:
    autonomous_action_allowed: true
    human_in_proximity: true
    e_stop_mechanism: "Hardware-wired cut to motor driver"
  invariants:
    - "No motor PWM permitted without active MCU watchdog tick"
    - "Motion prohibited outside 50cm bounding cube"
```

## Requirements and Physical Budgets Ledger (@sec-body)

physical_budgets_ledger:

## Observation Contract Schema (@sec-perception)

```yaml
observation_contract:
  version: "1.0"
  sensors:
    - sensor_id: "CAM_WRIST_RGB"
      modality: "RGB"
      resolution: [640, 480]
      frame_rate_hz: 60
      transport: "MIPI_CSI2_DMA"
      timestamp_sync: "PTP_IEEE1588"
      latency_budget_ms: 16.6
    - sensor_id: "JOINT_ENCODER_BUS"
      modality: "Absolute Optical"
      sample_rate_hz: 1000
      transport: "EtherCAT"
      latency_budget_ms: 1.0
  fallbacks:
    max_dropped_frames_before_halt: 2
    sensor_dropout_action: "TRIGGER_STATE_DRIFT_ALARM"
```

## Enforcement Design and Simplex Filter (@sec-enforcement)

```yaml
enforcement_design:
  version: "1.0"
  mcu_filter_frequency_hz: 1000
  barrier_functions:
    - name: "WorkspaceGeofence"
      type: "CONTROL_BARRIER_FUNCTION"
      inviolable_bound: "x^2 + y^2 <= (0.50)^2"
    - name: "DynamicStoppingClearance"
      inviolable_bound: "d_clearance >= v * t_delay + v^2 / (2 * a_max) + delta_margin"
  tracking_error_inset_margin_m: 0.015
  fallbacks:
    tier_1: "CBF_QP_ACTIVE_INTERVENTION"
    tier_2: "BASELINE_DECELERATION_SPLINE"
    tier_3: "DYNAMIC_BACK_EMF_BRAKING"
    tier_4: "STO_HARDWARE_POWER_TRIP"
```
